recipe.visualDefinition: A centered vertical oval vignette containing a live performance photograph, set against a full-bleed coarse burlap or linen fabric texture. The typography is split between a top-edge serif line and a custom arched logotype that follows the curve of the oval frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Oval frame acts as a window into a dark, high-contrast stage environment.
Burlap texture provides a tactile, organic contrast to the smooth photographic insert.
Arched lettering mirrors the curvature of the central visual anchor.
Warm, desaturated color palette unifies the disparate textures.
coreInvariants: High-contrast stage lighting within the oval
Arched text following the top curve of the oval

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A musician with an acoustic guitar is centered within a vertical oval that occupies approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central oval vignette containing the musician.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top horizontal text, moves down to the arched name, enters the oval frame to the subject's face, and follows the guitar neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of textured burlap in the four corners surrounding the oval.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows (inside the oval)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Denim blue and warm wood tones (subject clothing and instrument)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the bright burlap and the dark stage background.

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Wide-tracked, thin slab-serif capitals.
Main name: Arched path, high-contrast serifs with decorative swashes on initial and terminal letters.
Outlined letters for the arched text to separate from the background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the 'D' and 'S' to frame the name.
Curved baseline for the primary name to match the oval frame.

composition.position: arched over the top of the oval

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide-tracked architectural slab-serif paired with a flamboyant, arched decorative serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif feel with swash alternates.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked top metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-resolution background of coarse, light-brown burlap fabric. In the center, place a vertical oval window showing a 1970s-style photograph of a country musician in a cowboy hat playing an acoustic guitar on a dark stage with warm spotlighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of wide-spaced slab-serif text at the very top. Below that, add a large name in an arched decorative serif font that follows the top curve of the oval, featuring thin dark outlines and light cream fills.

verificationChecks: Is the burlap texture visible in the corners?
Is the central image contained within a clean oval?
Does the main text follow the curve of the oval?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Amount of swash on the decorative lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician
Exact brand logos on the guitar headstock
Specific wording of the original text

avoid: Default digital fonts without tracking adjustments

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text tracking at the top is sufficiently wide.
Ensure the oval border is thin and subtle.
Verify the burlap texture does not overlap the interior of the oval.
Confirm the musician's hat and guitar are clearly defined against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Burlap Texture + Centered Oval Vignette + Arched Decorative Serif + Wide-Tracked Header = 70s Country Aesthetic
